name: mnemonic_kinetic_graft
label: Mnemonic Kinetic Graft
poeticVision: The player experiences Lyra's movement as a constantly shifting landscape of physical laws. Each memory shard she interacts with temporarily rewrites her kinetic capabilities, forcing her to instantly adapt to a new form of locomotion – plummeting, gliding, pushing through, or becoming briefly unshakable. This creates a desperate, exhilarating dance of constantly re-learning how to survive, where mastery means exploiting momentary distortions in reality. The grief of identity loss is palpable, as even her most fundamental physical interactions become unstable, a reflection of her fracturing self.
usage: Attach this script to a CharacterBody3D node representing Lyra. Configure the 'Base Movement' parameters in the Inspector. To activate a kinetic graft, call the `activate_kinetic_graft(profile_name: String)` method from another script (e.g., a MemoryShard script) when Lyra interacts with a memory shard. For instance, a MemoryShard node could emit a signal `memory_shard_collected(profile_id: String)` which Lyra's script connects to, then calls `activate_kinetic_graft(profile_id)` with the appropriate profile name (e.g., "light_glide"). The active graft will automatically deactivate after its specified duration.

parameters.name: base_speed
parameters.description: The base movement speed of Lyra when no kinetic graft is active or when a graft doesn't modify speed.

parameters.name: base_jump_velocity
parameters.description: The base vertical velocity applied when Lyra jumps, modified by active grafts.

parameters.name: gravity
parameters.description: The gravitational force applied to Lyra, scaled by active grafts.

parameters.name: _kinetic_profiles
parameters.description: An internal dictionary defining various kinetic graft profiles. Each key is a profile name (String), and its value is a dictionary containing parameters: 'gravity_scale' (float, multiplier for base gravity), 'speed_multiplier' (float, multiplier for base speed), 'jump_force_multiplier' (float, multiplier for base jump velocity; 0.0 disables jump), 'duration' (float in seconds), and 'description' (String for internal reference).

verdict: Lyra's very being becomes a canvas for memory's volatile brush, painting a desperate ballet of survival where every step is a fleeting echo of who she once was.
impact: This mechanic fundamentally redefines player movement, transforming it from a static set of abilities into a dynamic, unpredictable challenge directly tied to Lyra's fracturing identity. Players will constantly adapt to new physical laws, turning every escape and traversal into a desperate, exhilarating dance of re-learning and exploiting momentary distortions, deepening the emotional connection to Lyra's struggle against forgetting.
